description: React component for displaying and managing a list of available teams, allowing users to view team details and join teams through API calls.

methods.name: AvailableTeamsPanel
methods.description: React functional component that displays available teams and provides functionality for joining a team.

methods.name: fetchAvailableTeams
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch the list of available teams using an API call, updating component state.

methods.name: handleJoinTeam
methods.description: Handles the logic for a user to join a selected team, including API call and updating UI.
